fields.description: Weekly issue of MIAMI LIFE (Vol. 4, no. 38) dated November 5, 1927. Includes editorials and local commentary on Miami’s dependence on tourism and business conditions; Miami Beach council politics following the death of Bill Scott; Buena Vista residents’ complaints about increased taxation and reduced municipal services; discussion of a November 10 vote on legalizing jitney routes and broader transportation policy; a proposed municipal airport site in Biscayne Bay with references to Virginia Key and Terminal Island connections; notes on courthouse construction concerns; and reports/praise of Miami police actions and arrests, alongside assorted local columns, letters to the editor, and advertisements.
